coursename: GBIO 9511 Current Topics in Oral Health Research I
coursedescription: During this journal club students will meet regularly to discuss and critically evaluate published articles. This forum will allow students to learn about research and current innovative and significant topics in areas related to Oral Heath. Discussion will focus on research techniques, and application for evidence-based practice. Students will be expected to present at least twice during their time as MSOB students. 1-3 Credit Hours

coursename: GBIO 9521 Fundamentals of Oral Biology I
coursedescription: Using a combination of evidence based current literature and lecture this course will focus on Basic concepts in cell and molecular biology as they relate to in bioengineering in oral health, host –pathogen interactions, relationship between systemic and oral biology, role of nutrition in oral heath, vaccines and oral health as well as oral microbiome. 3-6 Credit Hours
